name: Emerald
description: Iron tier. Set bonus: Merchant's Favor

pages.title: Emerald
pages.text:
Gear for traders and raid defenders.

- **Tier:** Iron
- **Durability:** 500
- **Sword damage:** 6
- **Armor (full set):** 15

pages.title: Getting It
pages.text: Made straight from **emeralds**, so it's expensive on purpose.

pages.title: The Gear
pages.text:
- **Illager's Bane:** emerald weapons deal 50%% more damage to raiders (pillagers, vindicators, evokers, ravagers, and witches).
- **Prospector:** the emerald pickaxe has a 25%% chance to drop bonus experience when it mines an ore.
- **Lucky armor:** each piece adds 1 Luck, for better fishing and loot.
- **Shield:** blocking a raider knocks it back hard.

pages.title: Merchant's Favor
pages.text: **Full set bonus.** You count as a Hero of the Village (level I): villagers trade at a discount and sometimes toss you gifts.
